items.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic present-day traditional costume CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET. Landscape 1536x1024, 3:2, warm ivory background, elegant black serif title matching our established sheets. Three full-body turnarounds FRONT, SIDE, BACK of the SAME adult, head-to-toe, neutral standing with arms relaxed slightly away from torso; fourth narrow column for face portrait and textile/jewellery details. Realistic anatomy, skin and woven textiles; soft even studio light. Small clear labels. No scenery, watermark, legal status claim or unrelated cultural motifs. Back construction is conservative interpretation; avoid invented ornate back patterns. Keep all full-body figures the same height. Bare feet. Title exactly "KOCH — MAN". Reference image 1: MAIN costume and adult man identity reference, specifically the man on the RIGHT. Preserve his white cloth headband with small upright tied end, short black hair, plain fitted white short-sleeved undershirt, white wrapped dhoti and white waist wrap; deep red/maroon woven sash across his LEFT shoulder diagonally to opposite hip, wide navy-white-red geometric diamond section at shoulder, small spaced woven motifs further down sash. Reference image 2: SUPPORTING lower-body wrap and drape only for portions cropped off in image 1; do NOT substitute its colourful caps for the white headband. Do not copy the woman. Show the round dark shield and long straight blade from image 1 ONLY as separate small prop insets if space permits, not held in the main turnaround views. Preserve the clean white ensemble and distinct red sash.
